_comment: variant: ltw1 = KGW-style context-hashed green list (seeded by the previous token), ltw0 = unigram/fixed global green list -- the paper's more paraphrase-robust arm. Set it here or override with --variant; the output file is named after it automatically. k is the selector's context window and MUST be identical at generation and detection (the Detector class default was 10, which would replay a different gating decision than generation made). Sampling params are LTW's own loop, not the shared protocol, so its PPL is only comparable to its paired unwatermarked text. Add an "output_tag" ONLY when sweeping gamma/delta within one variant.
